editorial:
Imagine being the most powerful person on Earth, but you accidentally break the entire world. That is exactly where you find yourself in this wild ride. You get to follow a man who thinks he is a god, only to realize he has started a countdown to total destruction. The vibe is a strange mix of high-stakes panic and laugh-out-loud moments, as you watch this guy scramble to fix his mistakes while pretending he has a master plan. It feels like a giant prank on humanity, and you will find yourself rooting for him even though he is kind of a jerk.

The acting is top-notch, and the fast pacing keeps you glued to your seat. While some parts of the plot get a bit confusing, the big twists make it all worth it. If you enjoy stories about rich people failing miserably, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover that the disaster was actually a test created by the main character's own AI. He thinks he is saving the world, but the twist is that he is the only one who believes the threat is real. He ends up sacrificing his wealth and power to stop a fake bomb. He loses everything but finally becomes a good person, ending the movie as a happy, broke man.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and stories about powerful people falling from grace.
